sources.name: Ruby Advisory Database
sources.license: Contributor public-domain policy, with stated OSVDB-attributed-data exceptions; review LICENSE.txt before reuse
sources.available_cases: 500 advisory YAML paths observed in the selected core-target inventory; this is not a total or runnable-case count
sources.notes: Primary concrete-ID source for this catalog. One YAML file is stored per advisory beneath gems/ or rubies/ and includes version ranges and references. Catalog candidates link to those exact paths.

sources.name: GitHub Advisory Database / Global Security Advisories API
sources.available_cases: Live reviewed-advisory inventory filterable by ecosystem=rubygems; count intentionally not frozen
sources.notes: OSV-formatted records with affected version ranges, first patched versions when known, CWEs, references, and potentially fix-commit references. Re-query before choosing a case.

sources.name: OSV.dev
sources.license: Apache-2.0 for osv.dev infrastructure; individual advisory provenance and reuse terms must be checked
sources.available_cases: Live package-version and commit-hash query service; count intentionally not frozen
sources.notes: Aggregates databases using the OSV format. Suitable for version/commit confirmation and dependency-environment filtering, not a claim that a candidate is runnable.

sources.name: CVEfixes v1.0.8
frameworks: Multi-language open-source projects; Ruby subset must be queried
sources.available_cases: 12,107 fixing commits / 11,873 CVEs / 4,249 projects overall through 2024-07-23; Ruby partition not asserted
sources.notes: Patch-level relational dataset, 12.7 GB download. Use SQL filtering and independently check the language and upstream snapshot before importing any Ruby row.

sources.name: Ruby on Rails upstream corpus
sources.available_cases: Project corpus only; no additional vulnerability-case count asserted
sources.notes: Large, modular MVC framework repository and appropriate upstream for many Ruby Advisory Database candidates.

sources.name: Sinatra upstream corpus
sources.available_cases: Project corpus only; no additional vulnerability-case count asserted
sources.notes: Lightweight route/DSL framework with a Rack-based test model.

sources.name: Hanami upstream corpus
sources.available_cases: Project corpus only; no additional vulnerability-case count asserted
sources.notes: Full-stack framework assembled from smaller Rack-compatible components; includes unit and integration test commands.

sources.name: Grape upstream corpus
sources.available_cases: Project corpus only; no additional vulnerability-case count asserted
sources.notes: API-framework corpus with an RSpec suite and SimpleCov configuration.

sources.name: Roda upstream corpus
sources.available_cases: Project corpus only; no additional vulnerability-case count asserted
sources.notes: Small Rack-oriented routing framework whose upstream suite uses minitest/spec.

sources.name: Padrino upstream corpus
sources.available_cases: Project corpus only; no additional vulnerability-case count asserted
sources.notes: Sinatra-derived full-stack framework with modular components.
